_doc: The swamp's special sites (bead bzc.126, docs/art/classes/map-objects.md, docs/design/CONTENT_MAP_OBJECTS.md 3.15): the Witch's Hut and the Sunken Ruins (2x2 on 128 x 128) and the Hag's Cauldron (1x1 on 64 x 64). generate-image-v2 at native display size like set map-objects; the imported sawmill is the style image for outline, pixel size and viewing angle only. Layers: style, light-south-west, class-map-object, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleSawmill.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: a swamp witch's hut on stilts: a small crooked wooden shack of dark brown planks #6a4a30 with #3e2c1e shadows standing high on four tall thin wooden stilts, a steep sagging thatched roof of olive reeds #8a8a48 with a bent chimney, a round window glowing warm yellow #f0c860, a rickety ladder from the ground up to its little porch door, bundles of dried herbs and a string of small bones hanging under the porch, a few tufts of moss #6b7f3c on the roof. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, witch, cat, ground, water, puddle, grass, sky, smoke, flag

recipes.subject: Subject: sunken temple ruins of the swamp, a creature bank: the top of an old drowned stone temple of grey-green mossy stone blocks #7a8270 with #4a5248 shadows tilted and sinking, a dark arched doorway framed by two broken pillars, a cracked stone face carved over the arch, thick green moss #6b7f3c and hanging vines over the stones, a few tall reeds and a broken stone urn at the front. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, skeleton figure, ground, water, lake, puddle, grass, sky, tree, flag

recipes.subject: Subject: a hag's cauldron of the swamp: a big round black iron cauldron #2e2e34 on three short legs over a small fire of crossed sticks with orange flames #f08a2a, bubbling over with bright green brew #7ee05a that drips down its sides, a few round bubbles above it, a crooked wooden ladle sticking out, a small skull and a bunch of herbs beside it. About three quarters of the image wide and tall, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, witch, hag, ground, puddle, grass, sky, smoke cloud, flag, house
